mission: Root-cause each confident-but-wrong contact finding left by e09 (ORANGE); fix only the defensible ones; document the rest as RED residuals with regression fixtures; report wrong-marker rate before/after on committed contact gold grouped by bundle.

findings.title: Foreign paddle WITHIN reach of an idle target wrist -> confident wrong contact at the opponent's hit
findings.status: OPEN (documented RED residual, now pinned by a committed regression test)
findings.reproduction: synthetic; estimate lands at truth+600ms (opponent hit) with confidence 0.778, ballConfirmed AND paddleConfirmed
findings.rootCause: The e09 reach tether is a spatial envelope, not an identity: a paddle track that switched to the opponent's paddle while hovering ~0.9 torso from the target's idle off-hand wrist passes the tether; its arc plus the ball turn at the opponent's hit then confirm a contact at the wrong moment.
findings.whyNotFixed: Distinguishing it requires upstream paddle-track identity association (outside contact-code ownership). Tightening the tether distance or maxPeakDivergenceMs would be tuning against a synthetic attack with no real-gold support (e09's stated position, re-verified).
findings.regressionFixture: packages/vision-geometry/test/contactRedTeam.test.ts :: 'F3 residual (documented RED): a foreign paddle WITHIN reach of an idle target wrist still yields a confident wrong contact' (pins the failure envelope so any behavior change is noticed, not silently shipped)

findings.title: Gap-censoring RAISED confidence on committed real gold (sasebo 52019: 144ms wrong at confidence 0.792, ballConfirmed)
findings.discovery: Fresh replay of the committed contact gold at the integration head FAILED the e02 eval gate: wavea-sasebo-volleys target event gold=52019ms estimated 51875ms (err 144ms > 132ms acceptable) at confidence 0.792 with ballConfirmed - a confident wrong marker the committed e02 artifact (err 16ms @ 0.705, commit f2dedf7) did not have.
findings.rootCause: Merge interaction: e02 and e09 both derived 'contact-evidence-4.2' on parallel branches. After the merge, e09's occlusion-gap censoring (gapCensorMs 150) crushes the only true-location ball direction change (sparse oracle ball annotation: 500ms gap after the turn sample at 52053) to 0.3x mass. Confidence coherence = chosenModeDensity / totalSurvivingMass, so removing the dissenting turn mass SHRANK the denominator and RAISED confidence 0.705 -> 0.792 while the estimate drifted to ball-wrist-proximity + wrist-peak evidence at 51875 (144ms early).
findings.fix: Structural invariant, no threshold changed: each kernel records the boundary/gap censor factor applied to its mass; the confidence coherence denominator restores the censored-away mass (mass / censorFactor). Censoring is loss of information and can now never RAISE confidence by silencing dissent. Estimate locations, abstentions, and all gating are byte-identical; only confidences at censored scenes drop (sasebo row 0.792 -> 0.683, below the 0.7 confirm band).
findings.regressionFixture: packages/vision-geometry/test/contactRedTeam.test.ts :: 'a gap-censored ball track yields no more confidence than the same track fully observed' (dense 0.868 vs gapped 0.550 on the synthetic pair; property is an inequality, not a tuned constant)

honestyNotes: Total wrong-marker rate is UNCHANGED (3/12): the fix does not move any estimate; it removes the false confidence that made one wrong marker a silent, ballConfirmed >=0.7 failure. The remaining 3 wrong markers (155/144/148ms) all sit at confidence <=0.683 and are not modality-silent: each carries limiting factors.
Coverage/abstention unchanged (12 estimated / 4 abstained before and after) - no abstention was purchased.

The e02 committed artifact (0 wrong markers) was measured pre-e09-merge at commit f2dedf7; the regression this workstream found and fixed was introduced by the e02+e09 merge, not by e02 or e09 alone. The eval harness rewrites datasets/experiments/wave-e/e02-contact-gold-replay-metrics.json in place on every run; that file was restored to its committed state and is NOT modified by this branch.
F3 remains an open RED residual: 590ms wrong at confidence 0.778 with both modalities confirmed on the synthetic reproduction. It is pinned by a committed regression test, not fixed.
